## What I did today

In the morning session we will learn how to use pixi environment. 

### 1.Installation of Pixi
```wget -qO- https://pixi.sh/install.sh | sh````

### 2. Create a new project
```pixi init lina_pixi_training -c conda-forge -c bioconda```` 
# -c stands for channel, conda-forge and bioconda are channels that contain the packages we need.
# this creates a folder and a file pixi.toml
